description.value: Hotel Rialto is a family-owned heritage boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Victoria, built on a dream by Italian immigrant Danilo Danzo who first visited in the late 1960s and later transformed the building into a love letter to his homeland. The five-storey property sits at the edge of Canada's oldest Chinatown, surrounded by eclectic local shops and walkable to Victoria's main attractions. The on-site Palms Inspired Kitchen and Cocktails is cited as one of the city's top restaurant and lounge experiences, with Vintage Spirits next door.
